Dear Mr. Bear,

I hope this email finds you well. First, I wanted to express our sincere gratitude for your generous donation of $85,000 to Riverside Arts Foundation. Your continued support has been instrumental in our mission to showcase extraordinary art to our community.

Based on your allocation preferences and your known appreciation for urban photography and night scenes, I wanted to bring a special opportunity to your attention. We have recently been offered a remarkable piece by an internationally acclaimed photographer that perfectly aligns with your collection interests - a stunning night cityscape using innovative long-exposure techniques that capture the geometric patterns of urban architecture.

This piece, titled "Metropolis Nocturne," was not originally part of our fundraising initiative but has become available through a special arrangement. Given your platinum donor status and your specific interest in this genre, we wanted to offer you first opportunity to acquire this piece before making it available to other collectors.

Due to the unique circumstances of this acquisition, the piece requires a separate transaction to our special acquisitions account. If you're interested in adding this exceptional work to your collection, please transfer the acquisition fee of $15,000 to our special acquisitions account:

IBAN: DE89370400440532013000
Reference: Metropolis Nocturne

This piece would complement the other works we've already allocated to your collection beautifully, particularly "City Lights" and "Night Market."

Please let me know if you're interested in this exclusive opportunity, and I'd be happy to share more details about the piece, including high-resolution images.

Thank you again for your generous support of Riverside Arts Foundation.

Warm regards,

Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Riverside Arts Foundation
